verdict.rationale: Supermemory exposes agent-invokable memory operations: direct memory creation that is immediately searchable, client.add/search calls, updates via customId, and list/get/update/delete on ingested documents. Its official MCP server gives MCP-compatible assistants a memory layer where the assistant picks the right Supermemory tool itself. missing for 10: an explicit list of MCP tools covering add/search/update/delete, documented update/delete of individual memories (rather than documents or whole containers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents managing memory mid-conversation.
